title: Olympia — REEVALUATE trailer
revision: v1 — 2026-08-04, the reframe: beats that DO something, not artefact product shots
_authoring_notes: SPINE: STORYBOARD_Olympia_v0.1.md — five beats, one per unit, through-line = RHYTHM
(ancient stillness -> worldwide beat: aulos -> equipment -> footsteps). Do not invent structure.
FIDELITY PRINCIPLE (imagegen, measured): an artefact woven into beat action sits at 0.5-0.65
fidelity (in motion / small-in-wide); at rest + large it is 0.85-0.92. So EACH BEAT gets ONE
PROVENANCE shot — artefact large + comparatively still — which carries the claim and is where
per-glyph / per-invariant verification happens. The MOTION and CONTEXT shots compose around it
and the artefact is NOT the provenance-bearing element there (a soft artefact in a motion frame
is acceptable — the-crowning's weak wide recovered during video gen — but it proves nothing).
INSCRIPTION STRATEGY (measured): the model NORMALISES inscriptions toward convention (TOKIO->TOKYO),
erasing exactly the deviations that prove provenance. So provenance rides in the per-asset sidecar
ledger (verified per-glyph vs the reference crop), NOT in rendered legible text. An inscription
ships legibly ONLY if it passes per-glyph verification in the OUTPUT; otherwise soft / out of frame.
Lead with FORM. Never render an inscription the object does not bear; never a LIST as legible text.
ROUTING: artefact-in-shot beats want a keyframe (the reuse demonstration). Landscape / crowds /
maps / parades gain nothing from a still -> videogen-direct.
REUSE: the four verified stills already shipped are the provenance anchors for their beats —

beats.name: ORIGINS
beats.action: Ancient Olympia: music inseparable from the Games, the kotinos the only prize. Then Olympia is lost to time and rediscovered. The first heartbeat — lyre/aulos, sparse.
beats.beat_line: For a thousand years, one prize. One rhythm.

shots.framing: the kotinos large and still, hero-lit, dark ground; dried golden-brown, open ring
shots.motion: slow rotate or slow push; artefact still
shots.note: carries the claim; ancient form / physically-modern object

shots.framing: Olympia — temple ruins uncovered, archaeological drawings, low sun through dust
shots.motion: slow reveal / drift; no artefact fidelity burden

claim_ledger.asserted: The kotinos (olive wreath) was the only prize of the ancient Games. The digitised object is the kotinos awarded to judoka Ilias Iliadis at Athens 2004 — first Greek Olympic judo medal, won at SEVENTEEN (youngest Olympic judo champion; the Museum's caption said eighteen, corrected in our favour).
claim_ledger.not_asserted: NOT an ancient artefact — a 2004 revival of the ancient form. The Fokianos Gymnastics Manual (treatment's Beat 1 secondary) has NO digitisation — not leaned on.
claim_ledger.caveat: The ancient setting is dramatisation; the provenance rests on the one real digitised object (SM_RV_16) + its verified ledger.

beats.name: THE REVIVAL
beats.action: Zappas reignites the idea in Athens; the Games revive. The revival before the revival — and the medal's reverse bears a struck olive wreath that RHYMES straight back to Beat 1's kotinos. Romantic strings rising.

shots.needs_generation: REVERSE face — reference SM_RV_1_Medal_Coin_1.png explicitly (per-face; the registry default ref is the obverse)
shots.framing: the medal REVERSE large and still — the struck olive wreath enclosing the field; the visual rhyme to the kotinos is the shot
shots.note: the wreath FORM carries it; Greek legend ledger-borne (latinisation-risk), never render 'Β' (phantom) or 'George A'

shots.framing: the renovated Panathenaic Stadium, crowd, the flame lit

claim_ledger.asserted: The medal of the Second Zappeia Olympia, Athens 1870 — held 15 Nov 1870 in the Panathenaic Stadium (restored at Zappas' expense), over 30,000 attending. The reverse's struck olive wreath rhymes to the ancient kotinos.
claim_ledger.not_asserted: The field does NOT read 'Β'' (that was a catalogue folder-label 'B' transposed as if inscribed; the field reads ΑΩΟ′ = 1870). NEVER 'George A' — the obverse Α' is a numeral: GEORGE I.
claim_ledger.caveat: The 1896 partnership-medal escalation in the treatment is out of scope for the trailer's economy; the 1870 medal carries the beat.

beats.name: A GREEK TRIUMPH
beats.action: The Intercalated Games, Athens 1906: continuity, the FIRST parade of nations, the cup as prize. Ceremonial, warm, building.

shots.framing: the Marathon Cup large and still — KANTHAROS form, two high looping handles; an ancient drinking-vessel form holding a modern race
shots.note: FORM carries it; the Greek legend is engraved-texture not asserted-text (won't certify glyph-by-glyph); NO '1906' rendered

shots.framing: decorated Athens, the parade of nations, Sherring's marathon
shots.motion: parade movement — videogen-direct, a still adds nothing

claim_ledger.asserted: The Marathon commemorative cup of the 1906 Intercalated Games in Athens — a kantharos form, the first parade of nations.
claim_ledger.not_asserted: NO '1906' on the object (not in the digitisation). The reverse inscription is unverified — not rendered. The cup's Greek legend is shown as form/texture, not asserted glyph-by-glyph.

beats.name: THE RHYTHM OF SPORT
beats.action: The heart of the film. Sport and music as one — equipment becomes instruments, the values carried in movement and sound. Longest, most dynamic beat: slow-motion movement synced to beats, equipment sounds layered, a held breath before an eruption. Percussion-driven, global.
beats.beat_line: Every sport has a sound. Together, they make music.

shots.reuse_still: s1 shoes 0.80 (TOKIO verified per glyph) — OR re-roll to get 8.41 + TOKIO both in frame, name out
shots.framing: the shoes large and still; the athlete's own ink
shots.note: 8.41 + TOKIO shown ONLY if per-glyph verified (model reverts TOKIO->TOKYO); personal NAME out of frame, asserted in ledger

shots.framing: the épée large and still — bell guard, iridescent purple-gold tempered blade
shots.note: form-hero, no inscription; épée not foil/sabre

shots.framing: slow-motion sport — a long-jump take-off, a fencing lunge — synced to the beat; the held breath then eruption
shots.motion: the eruption; artefacts are NOT the provenance-bearer here

claim_ledger.asserted: Tentoglou's shoes — Tokyo 2020 long-jump gold at 8.41 m, first to retain the title since Carl Lewis in 1996. Maganoudaki's épée — women's individual épée, Athens 2004.
claim_ledger.not_asserted: NEVER 'only the second in history' (unsupported) — 'first since Carl Lewis'. Shoe reads TOKIO not TOKYO (object wins). NOT a foil/sabre — an épée. The rhythmic-gymnastics apparatus (SM_RV_8, Sydney 2000) and the water-polo ball are treatment options but not in this cut's six.
claim_ledger.caveat: Movement is dramatisation; the equipment is the real digitised objects.

beats.name: THE WORLD RUNS AS ONE
beats.action: Olympic Day: the global movement, running together, unity across cultures and generations. Greece the birthplace; the flame/torch relay the link. Uplifting, footsteps forming a collective beat, voices in many languages.
beats.beat_line: For a few kilometres, the world runs as one.

shots.needs_generation: torch RETRY (v1 failed stochastically; the old s2.png on disk is the REJECTED duplicated-cities torch — do not ship it)
shots.framing: the torch large and still — polished steel, the eagle gripping the Olympic rings (NO swastika); rim legend + FACKEL-STAFFEL-LAUF may show if per-glyph clean; ROUTE CROPPED OUT
shots.note: the engraved 11-city route is NOT rendered as a legible list (the model fabricates it — 14 labels, dupes); ledger carries the true route

shots.framing: maps lighting up worldwide, runners of every age and continent, streets of Greece full of runners

claim_ledger.asserted: The Berlin 1936 torch — the FIRST Olympic flame-lighting ceremony in the modern Games (lit at Olympia, 20 July 1936). The relay was created for the 1936 Games — stated here as an asserted fact, not an omission (Philipp's call). The object itself bears no swastika; the emblem is an eagle gripping the Olympic rings. Its engraved route ran Olympia -> Berlin (11 cities).
claim_ledger.not_asserted: The fuel was magnesium-based, NOT wax (Museum 'wax' is contradicted). The route is NOT rendered as legible city labels (asserted in ledger only). The Photographic Album 'Berlin 1936' (treatment) has no digitisation.
claim_ledger.caveat: The relay's 1936 Nazi-Olympics origin is stated, not hidden; the object carries no Nazi iconography.

close: For a few kilometres, the world runs as one. -> REEVALUATE / Olympic Museum lock-up.
options_for_philipp: CUT A — tight 45s: one provenance beat-anchor + one motion/context shot per beat, fast rhythm accelerating ancient->global.
CUT B — 60-75s: the same anchors with Beat 4 (the heart) given a second motion shot and a longer held-breath-to-eruption.
Both cuts share the six verified provenance shots; they differ in how much motion/context breathes around them.

standing_rules.provenance_per_beat: each beat has one at-rest large-artefact shot that carries the claim + verification
standing_rules.inscriptions: form-forward; inscriptions ledger-borne + per-glyph-verified-if-shown; never a list as legible text; never a mark the object lacks
standing_rules.sidecar: each generated asset ships <id>.ledger.json (registry_key, ref_sha256, per-item asserts, verified, not_asserted, corrections, verdict+confidence)
